jChatBox.Chat.Event
Class ChatroomEvent

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--jChatBox.Chat.Event.ChatroomEvent
public class ChatroomEvent
extends java.lang.Object

This class provides chatroom events. Events are generated by Charoom instances and should be consumed by ChatroomListener instances.

Since:
2.6

getDescription

public java.lang.Object getDescription()
Optionnal description of the event. Return null except for the following events :
  • ADDINGUSER : (ChatroomUser) user
  • USERADDED : (ChatroomUser) user
  • REMOVINGUSER : (ChatroomUser) user
  • USERREMOVED : (ChatroomUser) user
  • ADDINGMESSAGE : (Msg) message
  • MESSAGEADDED : (Msg) message
  • USERBLACKLISTED : (ChatroomUser) user
  • IPUNBLACKLISTED : (String) IP address
  • CHATROOMOPENED : (String) "OPEN" or "REOPEN"

Returns:
